NODE_ENV.description: Process mode. production ignores the .env file and reads the injected environment only. Set to production by Dockerfile.brobot.prod.

PORT.description: HTTP port the API listens on.

DATABASE_URL.description: Postgres connection string (postgres://…). On k3s it comes from the CNPG cluster Secret, not the config store.

RUN_MIGRATIONS.description: Apply pending MikroORM migrations at boot, before listening. "false" skips them (local dev with db:schema:dev).

DOMAIN.description: Public hostname of this API, no scheme (e.g. admin.brobot.live). EventSub callbacks go to https://$DOMAIN/twitch/….

UI_URL.description: The public site (brobot-admin-ui): where the OAuth callbacks send the browser, and the base of the links the bot posts in chat. Its origin must be in ALLOWED_ORIGINS.

ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated bare browser origins (scheme://host[:port]) allowed by CORS. At least one.

JWT_ACCESS_SECRET.description: Signs brobot session access tokens. At least 32 characters, different from JWT_REFRESH_SECRET. Rotating it signs everyone out.

JWT_REFRESH_SECRET.description: Signs brobot session refresh tokens. At least 32 characters, different from JWT_ACCESS_SECRET.

BROBOT_SERVICE_TOKEN.description: Bearer secret api-time presents on /api/internal/transfer/*; api-time's own BROBOT_SERVICE_TOKEN holds the same value. At least 32 characters.

TWITCH_CLIENT_ID.description: Client id of the Twitch application.

TWITCH_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Client secret of the Twitch application.

TWITCH_CALLBACK_URL_USER.description: Redirect URI of the viewer login flow (…/api/auth/twitch/callback); must be registered on the Twitch application.

TWITCH_CALLBACK_URL_STREAMER.description: Redirect URI of the streamer flow (…/api/auth/twitch/streamer/callback); must be registered on the Twitch application.

TWITCH_CALLBACK_URL_BOT.description: Redirect URI of the bot flow (…/api/auth/twitch/bot/callback); must be registered on the Twitch application.

TWITCH_STREAMER_OAUTH_ID.description: Numeric Twitch user id of the streamer: the only account the streamer flow accepts, and the channel EventSub subscribes to.

TWITCH_BOT_OAUTH_ID.description: Numeric Twitch user id of the bot account: the only account the bot flow accepts.

TWITCH_STREAMER_CHANNEL_LISTEN.description: Twitch channel (login name) the bot joins and listens to.

TWITCH_BOT_USERNAME.description: The bot account's Twitch login name, as it chats.

EVENT_SUB_SECRET.description: Secret Twitch signs EventSub webhook deliveries with. 10–100 characters (Twurple). Required even with TWITCH_EVENTSUB_ENABLED=false.

WS_SECRET.description: Secret the streamer client (brobot-client) presents on the /api/ashketchum socket. At least 16 characters.

TWITCH_BOT_ENABLED.description: "false" keeps the chat bot, drops and channel-point reward handling offline; the HTTP API and the sockets still serve.

TWITCH_EVENTSUB_ENABLED.description: "true" mounts the EventSub webhook on /twitch/* and subscribes to channel-point redemptions and raids. Twitch must reach https://$DOMAIN/twitch/… on 443, so development leaves it off.

RIOT_API_KEY.description: Riot Games API key. Nothing reads it yet. Unset or blank = absent.

LICHESS_AUTH_TOKEN.description: Lichess API token sent with the !chess open challenge. Unset or blank → the challenge is created anonymously.

OPEN_API_KEY.description: OpenAI API key behind the @bot chat reply. Unset or blank → the bot does not reply.

OPENAI_MODEL.description: OpenAI chat model behind the @bot reply. Read only when OPEN_API_KEY is set.

STREAMLABS_CLIENT_ID.description: Streamlabs application client id. Nothing reads it yet. Unset or blank = absent.

STREAMLABS_SECRET.description: Streamlabs application client secret. Nothing reads it yet. Unset or blank = absent.

STREAMLABS_REDIRECT_URI.description: Streamlabs OAuth redirect URI. Nothing reads it yet. Unset or blank = absent.
